directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: I found your Terrorist, he coughed up the locations of all the charges, I already disarmed each one.
entries.JA_current: I found your Terrorist, he coughed up the locations of all the charges, I already disarmed each one.
entries.JA_new: テロリストを見つけた。爆弾の場所を全部吐かせて、俺が解除しておいた。

entries.EN: Well, holy shit, Marked One, you just impressed the hell out of me! I think you missed your calling, I can see a career in detective work for you! You have saved the lives of countless good men today, you've spared Duty the indignity of a hasty evacuation and saved our little oasis here from destruction. I have half a mind to take you on as Duty's personal problem solver, we could use a guy with your skills to take care of the mess out there. What should I reward you with? What do you want: artifacts? Money? Weapons or Armor?? No price can match what you've done, but I think we can come pretty close!

entries.JA_new: いや、すごいな、マークド・ワン！ 惚れ惚れする腕前だ。天職を間違えたんじゃないか？ 探偵として食っていけるぞ！ 今日、お前は大勢の仲間の命を救った。デューティーが慌てて避難する羽目になるのも防ぎ、この小さなオアシスを破壊から守った。デューティー専属の問題解決役として雇いたくなったよ。外の厄介事を片づけるのに、お前の腕が必要だ。報酬は何がいい？ アーティファクトか、金か？ 武器や防具もあるぞ。お前の功績に釣り合う値段はつけられないが、かなり近づけるはずだ！

entries.EN: I wish I had some money. I like money...
entries.JA_current: I wish I had some money. I like money...
entries.JA_new: 金が欲しい。金が大好きなんだ……

entries.EN: I want rare artifacts, and many of them.
entries.JA_current: I want rare artifacts, and many of them.
entries.JA_new: 珍しいアーティファクトを、たくさんくれ。

entries.EN: Weapons AND armor? Sounds good to me!
entries.JA_current: Weapons AND armor? Sounds good to me!
entries.JA_new: 武器と防具、両方か？ いいな！

entries.EN: What do I want? Just to live another day...
entries.JA_current: What do I want? Just to live another day...
entries.JA_new: 欲しい物？ ただ、明日も生きていたい……
